'''Bim Maldeen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] chief and the leader of the [[Nebula Masters]] on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. He controlled the streets of [[Gralleenya]].
